description: Land Title Settlement Department - Claims to land parcel in Rathnapura D/S Division & other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and property interests in various districts. The content focuses exclusively on land registration and title settlement matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land acquisitions, property ownership claims, and land title determinations.
